caption:
When a clinic tells you to wait, it can mean two very different things.

Sometimes it is about your skin: strong summer sun, something that needs to settle first, a condition that has to change before a treatment is safe. That kind of wait comes with a condition attached.

Sometimes it is only the calendar: a fully booked month, a holiday week, a pre-wedding rush. That kind of wait comes with a date attached.

Both are legitimate answers. They are just not the same answer, and it is fair to ask which one you are hearing. "Is that about my skin, or the schedule?" is a reasonable question in any consultation.

This is an observation about how clinics fill and empty, not a research finding.

General education only.
